text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash breathes a sigh of relief 
after safely finishing the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears the physical issues have been 
resolved. Carrying all the valuable 
experience gained from the Classic Triple 
Crown races, she heads toward the Japan 
Cup—
